lines.en: Tsubasa leads me away from the everblooming sakura into a hall full of old Japanese paintings I should probably know the names of but don’t.
lines.zh: Tsubasa 带我离开那棵常开不败的樱树,走进一座挂满古日本画的厅堂——那些画我大概该叫得出名字,却叫不出。

lines.en: I wouldn’t doubt if some of them are originals that I’m meant to be impressed by, but I refuse to be impressed by anything that’s so easily duplicated.
lines.zh: 我不怀疑其中几幅是真迹、是设计好让我叹服的。但凡是容易复制的,我一概拒绝叹服。

lines.en: My untrained eye wanders from canvas to canvas, hoping to pick up even a fragment of what makes this dimension so palatable for someone like Tsubasa, but I get caught up on her instead.
lines.zh: 我这双未经训练的眼睛从一幅画游到另一幅,想捕捉一丝让这个维度对 Tsubasa 这类人如此可口的片段,结果却在她身上卡住了。

lines.en: Beauty is supposed to be in the eye of the beholder anyway. And despite how frequently these eyes deceive me, I know what it is that I would prefer to waste away my days observing.
lines.zh: 反正美在观者眼中。而且,尽管这双眼睛频繁地欺骗我,我却知道自己更愿意用余生去凝视什么。

lines.en: There are no paintings that can bring me joy.
lines.zh: 没有任何画能给我带来快乐。

lines.en: Maybe once upon a time there were-
lines.zh: 也许从前有过——

lines.en: But there aren’t any left now.
lines.zh: 但现在一幅也不剩了。

lines.en: And if there are, I imagine they’re locked behind more doors in this palace than I’ll ever be able to open.
lines.zh: 而就算有,我猜它们也被锁在这座宫殿更多的门后,多到我永远打不开。

lines.en: Tsubasa says some things as she leads me down the hall, but none of them attach to whatever part of my brain is meant to process them.
lines.zh: Tsubasa 领我穿过走廊时说了些话,但没有一句挂得上我脑中负责处理它们的那部分。

lines.en: It isn’t until she leads me into a wide open, half-misty room that I remember what we’re doing or how to listen.
lines.zh: 直到她把我领进一间开阔而半带雾气的房间,我才想起我们在干什么,以及该怎么听。

lines.en: : This is one of Touka’s favorite additions to the manor and one that most people we bring here tend to enjoy very much.
lines.zh: : 这是 Touka 最喜欢的公馆新增设施之一,我们带来的大多数客人也都非常喜欢。

lines.en: : It’s nothing extravagant or historical like a special tree or a ceremonial room, but it houses a borderline-olympic sized heated pool.
lines.zh: : 它不像神树或仪式厅那样奢华或历史悠远,但里面装着一个接近奥运会规格的恒温泳池。

lines.en: : I used to spend a lot of time here when I was younger. I’m afraid I can seldom make the room in my schedule at this point, though.
lines.zh: : 我年轻时在这里度过许多时光。只是如今,日程里几乎腾不出这个空了。

lines.en: : If there's anything I've learned today, it's that you’re a lot busier than I ever really imagined you were.
lines.zh: : 如果说今天我学到了什么,那就是你比我想象中忙得多。

lines.en: : Did you assume I was just some woman living off of her husband’s money without making an effort to actually accomplish anything?
lines.zh: : 你该不会以为,我只是个花丈夫的钱、从不努力成就任何事的女人吧?

lines.en: : I don’t know if my thoughts were that specific.
lines.zh: : 我的想法有没有那么具体,我不确定。

lines.en: : It’s that sort of perception that comes with the territory when you marry into the most influential family in a city.
lines.zh: : 嫁进一座城市里最有影响力的家族,这种眼光是随之而来的。

lines.en: : I can guarantee you I’ve heard it all before.
lines.zh: : 我向你保证,这些话我全听腻了。

lines.en: : Of course, though, that’s not even remotely true.
lines.zh: : 当然,那也根本不是真的。

lines.en: : I suppose it’s just in my nature to always be doing something. I have a hard time pulling myself away from anything that could be called “productive” in some form.
lines.zh: : 我想,手头永远有事做是我的天性。任何勉强称得上「有产出」的事,我都难以抽身离开。

lines.en: : Which is why you’ll see me...offering to give tours. Or offering to babysit. Or offering to check in on remote onsens for the sake of the family business.
lines.zh: : 所以你会看到我……主动提出带导览。主动提出看孩子。或者为了家族生意,主动提出去偏远的温泉巡视。

lines.en: : I suppose that last one was a tad relaxing, though.
lines.zh: : 不过,最后那件,稍微有点放松。

lines.en: : Even with all of the noise.
lines.zh: : 哪怕噪音不少。

lines.en: : I have no idea what you’re talking about. Chika and I were just watching TV.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道你在说什么。Chika 和我只是看电视。

lines.en: : You’ll have to tell me what program. I can’t remember the last time I enjoyed watching TV that much.
lines.zh: : 那你得告诉我是哪个节目。我都不记得上一次看电视看得那么开心是什么时候了。

lines.en: : Wha-
: Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei?

lines.en: : What are you doing here?...
lines.zh: : 你怎么在这里?……

lines.en: : Being shocked at how you’re still in [high_school].
lines.zh: : 正惊讶于你居然还在 [high_school]。

lines.en: : Yes, but what are you doing here?
lines.zh: : 是,可你来这里干什么?

lines.en: : I invited him over to give him a tour of the manor, dear. I figured it was the least I could do to offer him thanks for his time at the arcade and...surrounding areas the other day.
lines.zh: : 是我请他来参观公馆的,亲爱的。我想,谢一谢他那天在街机厅和……周边区域的陪伴,是我至少能做的。

lines.en: : I see...
lines.zh: : 原来如此……

lines.en: : Have you been in there this whole time?
lines.zh: : 你一直泡在池子里?

lines.en: : I’ve been in here for at least an hour. If I’d known you were coming, I would have put on something more presentable.
lines.zh: : 我在这儿至少一小时了。早知道你要来,我会换身像样点的。

lines.en: : No worries. What you’re wearing is totally fine.
lines.zh: : 别在意。你这样穿完全没问题。

lines.en: : Are you enjoying the tour, at least? I’m assuming Mother already told you about the rock garden? She always likes to open up with that.
lines.zh: : 导览至少还愉快吧?我猜母亲已经跟你说过渡园了?她总喜欢拿那个开场。

lines.en: : I also showed him the golden room and told him all about how you’ve been dreaming of getting married there one day.
lines.zh: : 我还带他看了黄金厅,告诉他你一直梦想着有朝一日在那里成婚。

lines.en: : Wha- Mother?!
: Sensei has no interest in that! And those were just silly, girlish dreams!
lines.zh: : Sensei 对那种事毫无兴趣!那不过是些傻乎乎的少女梦!

lines.en: : Oh? So you don’t want to be married in the golden room anymore?
lines.zh: : 哦?所以你不想在黄金厅成婚了?

lines.en: : I...well...
: Touka darling, come out of the pool if you’re going to hold a conversation with us. It’s bad manners staying in there.
lines.zh: : Touka 亲爱的,既然要和我们交谈,就从池子里出来吧。泡在里面说话不礼貌。

lines.en: : Hah...yes, Mother...
lines.zh: : 哈……是,母亲……

lines.en: Touka exits the pool and wrings her hair back out into the water.
lines.zh: Touka 出了泳池,把头发拧干,水又落回池中。

lines.en: If her mother wasn’t standing beside me, I’d use this opportunity to make some perverted comment about the angle of her body as she does this.
lines.zh: 若她母亲不站在我旁边,我本会趁这个机会,就她拧发时的身体角度发表些下流评论。

lines.en: But, at the risk of forming an erection in the process of mentally describing that, I will elect to abstain.
lines.zh: 但冒着在脑内描述这一过程时竖起帐篷的风险,我选择弃权。

lines.en: : Oh my. Are you still growing, dear? You may even surpass me at this rate.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。你还在发育吗,亲爱的?照这个速度,你甚至可能超过我。

lines.en: Nevermind. Some things just can’t be contained.
lines.zh: 收回刚才的话。有些东西终究藏不住。

lines.en: : Mother, stop! Weren’t you just speaking of bad manners?!
lines.zh: : 母亲,住口!您刚才不还在说不礼貌吗?!

lines.en: : Oh, yes. Silly me. I was so impressed with your...progress, that I’d forgotten your teacher was even here.
lines.zh: : 哦,对。瞧我。我为你的……成长倾倒,竟忘了你的老师还在场。

lines.en: : I completely understand. I forgot as well for a second.
lines.zh: : 我完全理解。我也忘了一秒。

lines.en: : If you two are done objectifying me for now, I would like to go get dressed into something more suitable for the remainder of Sensei’s tour.
lines.zh: : 你们俩要是物化我物化够了,我想去换身更适合 Sensei 导览余下部分的衣服。

lines.en: : Oh, his tour is just about over for the day. I’ve been dragging him around all morning. Though, I suppose he was willingly following me, so perhaps he enjoyed it?
lines.zh: : 哦,他今天的导览差不多结束了。整个上午我一直拖着他到处跑。不过,他算是自愿跟着我的,所以也许他乐在其中?

lines.en: : I just didn’t want to get lost in the entire mini-city you’ve built for yourselves.
lines.zh: : 我只是不想在你们为自己造的整座迷你城市里迷路。

lines.en: : Have you really been here for that long? Why wasn’t I informed of this?
lines.zh: : 你真的来了这么久?为什么不通知我?

lines.en: : I honestly didn’t even think you’d be okay with me coming.
lines.zh: : 说实话,我以为你根本不会同意我来。

lines.en: : I’m...mostly indifferent to you coming. But if you’re here, I believe I should be involved in some way.
lines.zh: : 你来……我大体无所谓。但你既然来了,我想我该以某种方式参与。

lines.en: : I apologize for not telling you, dear. I’d just assumed you wanted the rest.
lines.zh: : 没告诉你,抱歉,亲爱的。我以为你想要清静。

lines.en: : My rest aside, I thought you had meetings today?
lines.zh: : 清静先放一边,你不是今天有会吗?

lines.en: : I was on call for meetings regarding some of the properties we saw the other day- but it appears that none of them ever happened.
lines.zh: : 我待命参加关于前几天看的几处房产的会议——但看起来,一场都没有开成。

lines.en: : Or at least no one’s been able to find me to inform me about them. You know our manor staff, though, so that doesn’t seem very probable.
lines.zh: : 或者说,至少没人找得到我来通知我。不过你了解我们公馆的佣人,所以那似乎不太可能。

lines.en: : Well...regardless, I’m going to go get changed.
lines.zh: : 嗯……无论如何,我去换衣服了。

lines.en: : Please inform me if you’re ever going to come here again. It’s one thing to appear casual at the dorms, but as the heiress of the Tsukioka Foundation, I can’t afford to be seen like this here.
lines.zh: : 下次再来这里,请务必通知我。在宿舍里随性是一回事,但身为 Tsukioka 财团的继承人,我不能在这里被人看到这副样子。

lines.en: : I have a reputation within the manor to uphold.
lines.zh: : 我在公馆里,也有形象要维持。

lines.en: : I won’t tell anyone if you don’t, dear. Now, go get dressed. We’ll stay here until you return.
lines.zh: : 你不说,我也不说,亲爱的。去换衣服吧。我们在这里等你回来。

lines.en: : Okay...
: Don’t go anywhere.
lines.zh: : 别走远。

lines.en: Touka grabs a towel off of a nearby rack and dries herself off before disappearing into the hall of a thousand paintings.
lines.zh: Touka 从旁边的架子上抓起毛巾擦干自己,然后消失在那座千画之厅里。

lines.en: That’s not an accurate number- just an estimation.
lines.zh: 那个数字不准确——只是个估算。

lines.en: : My lord. It feels like just the other day I was purchasing her luxury training bras.
lines.zh: : 我的天。感觉就在前几天,我还在给她买高级少女内衣。

lines.en: : That’s an item that probably shouldn’t exist.
lines.zh: : 那种东西大概不该存在。

lines.en: : But it does, and so she had them. Not for very long, though, as you can probably assume.
lines.zh: : 可它存在,所以她有过。不过时间不长——你大概能想象。

lines.en: : So I guess we’re talking about your daughter’s breasts now. Not really how I imagined this tour ending after 90%% of it was a history lesson.
lines.zh: : 所以我们现在是在聊你女儿的胸了。导览九成是历史课,我可没想过会这样收尾。

lines.en: : Just some passing commentary. That wasn't a topic I intended to remain on any longer- at least not without her present for it.
lines.zh: : 只是随口一提。那个话题我本不打算久留——至少不在她不在场的情况下久留。

lines.en: : I feel like having her present for it would make things even weirder.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她要是在场,事情只会更怪。

lines.en: : Perhaps it would.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。

lines.en: : Though, I wouldn’t say the same about what I feel we must discuss next.
lines.zh: : 不过,接下来我认为必须谈的事,我就不这么说了。

lines.en: : Which is?
lines.zh: : 是什么?

lines.en: : Would you find it rude if I took my shoes off? I don’t want to get in the pool, but I’d like to dip my feet in for a moment while we await my daughter’s return.
lines.zh: : 我脱鞋会不会失礼?我不想下水,但等女儿回来时,想先把脚泡进去一会儿。

lines.en: : Do whatever you want, it’s your house.
lines.zh: : 随你便,这是你家。

lines.en: : Excellent. Then, don’t mind me.
lines.zh: : 好极了。那就别管我。

lines.en: Tsubasa sits down on a fancy looking beach chair and unstraps whatever the elegant looking sandal things she’s wearing are called.
lines.zh: Tsubasa 在一把看起来很高级的沙滩椅上坐下,解开她脚上那双优雅凉鞋玩意儿的搭扣——我也叫不出名字。

lines.en: She catches me looking at her for a moment and kindly waves me off so she can remove her stockings as well and, reluctantly, I oblige.
lines.zh: 她逮到我盯着她看了一会儿,礼貌地挥手让我移开视线,好连丝袜也一并脱掉。我不情不愿地照办了。

lines.en: Once she’s done, she returns to me and sits down in front of the pool, hiking her dress up and dipping her toes into the water.
lines.zh: 等她弄完,她回到我身边,在池边坐下,撩起裙摆,把脚趾探进水里。

lines.en: I sit beside her, mostly certain and even more uncomfortable about what I believe she wants to discuss next.
lines.zh: 我在她身旁坐下,对自己猜测的她接下来想谈的事,基本确定,而且更加不安。

lines.en: : Do you know what it is I want to talk about, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你知道我想谈什么吗,Sensei?

lines.en: : Probably, but I’d prefer to not guess and just have you get it over with so I don’t have to risk guessing incorrectly.
lines.zh: : 大概知道。但我宁愿不猜,你直接说完,省得我赌错。

lines.en: : Then I suppose I’ll “get it over with” and save us the difficulty of prodding at one another until it’s out in the open.
lines.zh: : 那我就「说完吧」,省得我们互相试探,直到把话逼到明面上。

lines.en: : A young lady who I’ve grown rather fond of lately seems to believe that the two of you are involved in an exclusive relationship with one another.
lines.zh: : 一位我近来颇为疼爱的少女似乎相信,你们俩正处于一段彼此专属的关系中。

lines.en: : But that young lady is just that. Young.
lines.zh: : 但那位少女,终究只是少女。年轻。

lines.en: : And while I’m no stranger to the prospect of marrying someone older given that women have been traded between affluent families like cattle for centuries-
lines.zh: : 而虽然我对嫁给年长之人并不陌生——毕竟数百年来,女性一直像牲口一样在富家之间被交易——

lines.en: : I can’t help but get a little caught up when it comes to wrapping my mind around your situation.
lines.zh: : 一到理解你们的处境,我还是难免有点绕不过来。

lines.en: You know, when I first told Tsubasa that I’d be okay with spending more time with her, I worried that something like this might come up.
lines.zh: 你知道吗,当初我告诉 Tsubasa 我愿意多花时间和她相处时,就担心过这种事会出现。

lines.en: She’s one of the only people Chika trusts enough to talk about our “relationship” with, which is kind of odd considering Tsubasa was, at one point, just some random woman at an onsen.
lines.zh: 她是 Chika 唯几足够信任、愿意与之谈论我们「关系」的人之一。这有点怪——毕竟 Tsubasa 曾经只是温泉里的某个陌生女人。

lines.en: But she’s much more than that now. To Chika, at least.
lines.zh: 但现在,她远不止于此。至少对 Chika 而言。

lines.en: And to Tsubasa, Chika is important as well.
lines.zh: 而对 Tsubasa 来说,Chika 同样重要。

lines.en: So it only makes sense that she’d ask me about this now that she finally has an opportunity to.
lines.zh: 所以,既然她终于等到机会,来问我这件事,也就顺理成章。

lines.en: The only issue is that I don’t know what the right thing or the wrong thing to say is.
lines.zh: 唯一的问题是,我不知道什么话对,什么话错。

lines.en: Tsubasa seems like a rational and understanding person but, at the same time, she’s someone I’ve only known for a little while.
lines.zh: Tsubasa 看起来理性而善解人意,但与此同时,我认识她毕竟不久。

lines.en: And I’m less important to her than a surrogate daughter.
lines.zh: 而且在她心里,我比一个代养女儿还轻。

lines.en: In fact, I doubt I bear any sort of importance in Tsubasa’s life at all.
lines.zh: 实际上,我怀疑我在 Tsubasa 的人生里根本不占任何分量。

lines.en: So, I should probably tread carefully here.
lines.zh: 所以,这一步我大概得小心走。

lines.en: : What are you asking me?
lines.zh: : 你在问我什么?

lines.en: : Oh? Is that a trace of attitude I’m hearing?
lines.zh: : 哦?我怎么听出了一丝脾气?

lines.en: : Not intentionally. I’m just not sure how to answer a question that hasn’t been asked yet.
lines.zh: : 不是故意的。只是我不知道怎么回答一个还没被问出的问题。

lines.en: : And I’m not quite sure what I want to hear.
lines.zh: : 而我也不太确定自己想听什么。

lines.en: : On one hand, I want the young lady I care about to be happy. But when you really think about what it is that’s making her happy, the waters get a little muddy.
lines.zh: : 一方面,我希望我疼爱的少女幸福。可一旦细想是什么让她幸福,水就有点浑了。

lines.en: : I don’t-
lines.zh: : 我没有——

lines.en: : You are a grown man sleeping with a girl in [high_school]. Sleeping with your student.
lines.zh: : 你是一个和 [high_school] 女孩上床的成年男人。和你的学生上床。

lines.en: : Aren’t you even a little worried about what could happen to you if that information were to get out?
lines.zh: : 这要是传出去,你会落得什么下场——你就一点都不担心?

lines.en: : Are you grilling me as a friend or a parent right now?
lines.zh: : 你现在是在以朋友还是家长的身份审我?

lines.en: : Can it not be both?
lines.zh: : 不能两个都是吗?

lines.en: : Not when my answer would change based on yours.
lines.zh: : 我的回答会随你的身份而变,所以不能。

lines.en: : Then I suppose we can say I’m asking you as a friend.
lines.zh: : 那我想,可以说我是以朋友的身份在问你。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 我懂了。

lines.en: : Of course I’m worried about what would happen if that information were to get out.
lines.zh: : 那件事要是传出去我会怎么样,我当然担心。

lines.en: : And yet, I don’t really do anything to try and stop it apart from just...asking her to keep quieter.
lines.zh: : 可话虽如此,除了……让她声音小一点,我其实什么都没做去阻止它。

lines.en: : Do you love her?
lines.zh: : 你爱她吗?

lines.en: : Not the way I’m supposed to.
lines.zh: : 不是我「应该」的那种爱法。

lines.en: : And how is it you are supposed to love someone?
lines.zh: : 那一个人「应该」怎么爱?

lines.en: : The same way she loves me, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我猜,就是她爱我的那种方式吧。

lines.en: : Hm.
: You know, you can be pretty intimidating when you want to be.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗,你想吓人的时候,真能吓到人。

lines.en: : Women in power are good at that sort of thing.
lines.zh: : 掌权的女人,擅长那种事。

lines.en: : But if you want the truth, I’m not really appalled by what you do.
lines.zh: : 但如果你想要实话,你的所作所为其实并没有让我惊骇。

lines.en: : Like I said, that sort of thing doesn’t mean much to me when I’ve gone my whole life hearing stories of other women from my family being shipped off to men twice their age.
lines.zh: : 就像我说的,我这一辈子都在听家族里其他女人被打包送给岁数两倍于她们的男人——那种事对我早已没那么大冲击。

lines.en: : It loses its impact after a while.
lines.zh: : 听久了,冲击力就钝了。

lines.en: : What I’m worried about is whether or not you’re going to hurt that young girl- whether it be intentional or unintentional. Because I don’t know if she’d be able to handle it.
lines.zh: : 我担心的是,你会不会伤害那个年轻女孩——无论有意还是无意。因为我不知道她扛不扛得住。

lines.en: : Just going to stay silent forever?
lines.zh: : 就打算永远沉默下去?

lines.en: : Sometimes, silence is the best answer.
lines.zh: : 有时候,沉默是最好的回答。

lines.en: : And you think this is one of those times?
lines.zh: : 而你觉得,现在正是那种时候?

lines.en: : I’m not sure what this is.
lines.zh: : 我不确定现在算什么。

lines.en: : But if I had to guess, I’d wager that I am going to hurt her.
lines.zh: : 但非要我猜,我赌我会伤到她。

lines.en: : Life isn’t even half as convenient as it would need to be in order for me to avoid that.
lines.zh: : 人生远没有那么便利,便利到能让我避开它。

lines.en: : But I don’t intend to leave her side either.
lines.zh: : 但我也不打算离开她身边。

lines.en: : I don’t really think I could.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我也做不到。

lines.en: : Even if she winds up hating me for something I’ve done or...will do in the future, I’ll be there for her.
lines.zh: : 哪怕她最后因为我做过的事、或者……将来会做的事而恨我,我也会守在她身边。

lines.en: : So at least she won’t have to hurt alone.
lines.zh: : 所以至少,她不必独自受苦。

lines.en: : Granted, I’m not sure how much help my presence will be- especially when I’m worse at cheering people up or even just talking than anyone else I’ve ever met.
lines.zh: : 诚然,我不确定我的陪伴能帮上多少——尤其是,论哄人开心、甚至只是说话,我比此生遇到的任何人都差。

lines.en: : But I’ll be there.
lines.zh: : 但我会在。

lines.en: : She doesn’t have to be alone anymore.
lines.zh: : 她不必再一个人了。

lines.en: I think about how the water would feel against my skin.
lines.zh: 我想着池水贴上皮肤会是什么感觉。

lines.en: I shrug it off.
lines.zh: 我把念头甩开。

lines.en: That’s all I ever do.
lines.zh: 我一直只做这一件事。

lines.en: : That was a good answer.
lines.zh: : 那是个好回答。

lines.en: : We can’t prevent ourselves from hurting the people we care about. All we can do is pray it doesn’t happen and be prepared to suture the wounds if it does.
lines.zh: : 我们无法保证不伤害自己在乎的人。能做的只有祈祷它不发生,并在它发生时准备好缝合伤口。

lines.en: : As long as you’re not just using the girl, I can accept the nature of your relationship.
lines.zh: : 只要你不是单纯在利用那孩子,你们关系的性质,我可以接受。

lines.en: : At first, that’s exactly what it was.
lines.zh: : 起初,确实就是那样。

lines.en: : But it’s not anymore, is it?
lines.zh: : 但现在不是了,是吧?

lines.en: : Ah.
: Silence.
lines.zh: : 沉默。

lines.en: : It’s the best answer sometimes.
lines.zh: : 有时候,它确实是最好的回答。

lines.en: : I certainly picked an interesting class to enroll my daughter in, didn’t I?
lines.zh: : 我给女儿报的这门课,可真有意思,不是吗?

lines.en: : Probably the worst one possible. And I’ve always been a little curious about why.
lines.zh: : 可能是最糟的一个。而我一直有点好奇,为什么选它。

lines.en: : You’ve known about Chika and me since the beginning. I figured that would be all you need to know to keep Touka away.
lines.zh: : 你从一开始就知道我和 Chika 的事。我以为,光凭这个你就足以让 Touka 远离我的课。

lines.en: : Tell me...How deep do you think this pool is, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 告诉我……你觉得这池子有多深,Sensei?

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么?

lines.en: : When Touka was a little girl, she really wanted to learn how to swim.
lines.zh: : Touka 小时候,非常想学游泳。

lines.en: : We hired an entire team of renowned instructors to teach her. People from all over the globe, since they were still allowed in back then.
lines.zh: : 我们雇了整整一支名师团队教她。世界各地的人都有——那时候他们还被允许入境。

lines.en: : We spent so much money trying to help that little girl swim.
lines.zh: : 为了让那个小女孩学会游泳,我们花掉了数不清的钱。

lines.en: : But none of it worked.
lines.zh: : 但全都无用。

lines.en: : No matter who we hired or what their methods were, she just couldn’t learn.
lines.zh: : 无论我们请谁、方法如何,她就是学不会。

lines.en: : But one day, while the two of us were lounging near the poolside, I recalled a story one of my girlfriends told me about how she learned to swim when she was younger.
lines.zh: : 可有一天,我们俩正在池边闲躺,我想起我的一位女友讲过的故事——她小时候是怎么学会游泳的。

lines.en: : Her mother pushed her into the pool.
lines.zh: : 她母亲把她推进了池子里。

lines.en: : Terrified and wanting nothing more than to stay alive, her instincts kicked in and she managed to swim back to the ledge and pull herself out.
lines.zh: : 恐惧之下,她别无所求,只想活命。本能接管了一切——她游回了池沿,自己爬了上来。

lines.en: : You...pushed your daughter into the pool knowing full well she didn’t know how to swim?
lines.zh: : 你……明知她不会游泳,还把她推进池子?

lines.en: : And now you’re her teacher.
lines.zh: : 而现在,你是她的老师。

lines.en: : Sometimes, forcing people to do things they’re not comfortable with is the best way to move them forward.
lines.zh: : 有时候,逼人去做他们不自在的事,才是推动他们向前的最好办法。

lines.en: : I’ve known from the beginning that you were the exact opposite of what Touka needs.
lines.zh: : 我从一开始就知道,你是 Touka 所需之物的彻底反面。

lines.en: : And I think that’s exactly what makes her need you the most.
lines.zh: : 而我想,那恰恰是让她最需要你的原因。

lines.en: : Okay. But you have literally heard me have sex with a girl the same age as your daughter.
lines.zh: : 好。可你字面意义上听过我和一个与你女儿同龄的女孩做爱。

lines.en: : Lots of it.
lines.zh: : 还听了不止一次。

lines.en: : Are we ending the conversation here?
lines.zh: : 对话就到这里结束?

lines.en: : Yeah, I think we probably should.
lines.zh: : 嗯,我觉得最好如此。

lines.en: Tsubasa and I sit in silence until Touka returns wearing the same white dress she had on when I first met her.
lines.zh: Tsubasa 和我沉默地坐着,直到 Touka 穿着我初见她时那条白裙回来。

lines.en: Everything goes back to normal.
lines.zh: 一切恢复如常。

lines.en: And I, once again, manage to slip through the cracks of morality as I find that my newest acquaintance might also be a little broken as well.
lines.zh: 而我再一次从道德的缝隙间溜过——因为我发现,我这位最新的相识,可能也有一点点坏掉了。

lines.en: Just in a much more beautiful way than I am.
lines.zh: 只是坏得比我漂亮得多。

lines.en: Tsubasa’s affection has increased to [tsubasa_love]!
lines.zh: Tsubasa 的好感度提升到了 [tsubasa_love]!
